title: Adds a new structure error code to the Accounts API
summary: Adds verification_legal_entity_structure_mismatch as a new error code in the requirements.errors array in the Accounts API. To learn more, see Account requirements errors.
migrationNotes: Lets you specifically identify when there’s a mismatch in the legal entity structure during account verification.

sources.quote: | [Adds a new structure error code to the Accounts API](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2022-11-15/adds-structure-error-code-accounts.md) | Connect | Breaking | api |

Adds `verification_legal_entity_structure_mismatch` as a new error code in the `requirements.errors` array in the Accounts API. To learn more, see [Account requirements errors](https://docs.stripe.com/api/accounts/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20#account_object-requirements-errors).
